title: One camera, three distances that all have to work
summary: A scene is judged at overview, inspection and close-up. Design one detail level per distance instead of one dense model everywhere.
applies_when: interactive scene with orbit or free camera
any object the user can approach

values.silhouette_readability: hero must be identifiable as a flat black shape at overview
values.detail_budget_split: 60% overview silhouette, 30% inspection parts, 10% close-up surface

checks: hero silhouette is unambiguous at overview
no object has detail that only exists at close-up but is invisible at inspection
the camera never needs to clip through geometry to see the hero
close-up reveals contact and joins, not mush
limits: assumes a perspective camera with a 35-55 degree vertical field of view
does not cover orthographic diagram views
